edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: an existing abstract hand-inked game UI weapon icon, exported at 64x64. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. If Image 2 is present, it is a weapon sprite SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY. Edit the existing icon with the targeted change below. Preserve the thick rounded black-green #0b0e09 outline, flat ivory #f0efdb and muted forest green #40554a colors, simple cartoon pictogram style, and roomy transparent padding. Keep the icon's current orientation unless specified. Design for tiny 28–64 pixel display, maintain bold readable strokes and generous negative spaces. No text, badge, border, frame, background color, shading, glow, texture, or decorative detail. Return exactly one centered icon on a square canvas with actual transparent alpha. NEVER draw checkerboard or simulated transparency. If alpha output is unavailable, use solid pure magenta #ff00ff rather than any checkerboard. Change only what is requested, keep everything else as close to Image 1 as possible.
Targeted change: Lengthen the visible dark green spear shaft substantially: the shaft should account for about 55–60% of the overall spear length, with the compact ivory diamond-shaped head about 35–40%. Keep the diagonal lower-left to upper-right direction and current minimalist head silhouette. Fit the whole spear within the existing padded square. The shaft must read as a long pole, not a stubby knife handle. Do not add grip wraps or facet lines.
edits.background_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Remove ALL gray and white checkerboard background pixels from this game icon and return a PNG with a REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA CHANNEL. The checkerboard is unwanted background, not part of the icon. Preserve the colored weapon icon EXACTLY: its shape, black outlines, colors, size, position and proportions. Change only the background. Do not redraw, redesign, recolor or add detail. Do not draw transparency squares or any replacement backdrop. Actual transparent background.
